subject: Trident Networks SIG Questionnaire — artifact index, sample exports, and delivery timeline
messages:
From: Lisa Harper <lisa.harper@tridentnet.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.example.com
Cc: Trident Procurement <procurement@tridentnet.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2027 16:20:00 -0700
Subject: SIG questionnaire (v4) and ask: snapshots + sample exports

Hi Aditya,

Thanks again for the demo last week — product looked solid. Our procurement and security teams have started the SIG v4 questionnaire and we wanted to align on two things before we dive into full responses:

1) A mapping/template that shows Redwood's control owners and where you expect us to accept compensating controls versus mandatory artifacts. That helps our security reviewers triage.
2) A small set of sample artifacts we can review immediately (e.g., a redacted audit log export, an example KMS key rotation event, and a screenshot of the admin IAM role page).

Can you provide a crosswalk and an initial artifact bundle by EOD Monday (May 3)? We know some documentation will be delivered later, but the early artifacts will speed the review.

Also include a single point of contact for any SOC 2/ISO questions so we don’t open separate tickets.

Appreciate it —
Lisa
Lisa Harper
Security Program Manager | Trident Networks
lisa.harper@tridentnet.com
+1 (415) 555-0128

---
Attachment: SIG_v4_questionnaire_request.pdf (pdf, 230KB)
From: aditya_rao@redwood.example.com
To: Lisa Harper <lisa.harper@tridentnet.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.example.com, marissa_cole@redwood.example.com
Date: Sat, 01 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire (v4) and ask: snapshots + sample exports

Hi Lisa — thanks for the note and the clear asks. We can absolutely do that. High level plan below (will attach the crosswalk and a small artifact bundle in a follow-up):

1) Crosswalk: a single-sheet mapping (SIG control ID -> Redwood control narrative -> artifact name or compensating control). I’ll include recommended acceptance notes where the artifact is not required (e.g., control evidenced by process + dashboard).

2) Artifact bundle (initial):
   - redwood_routing_service_audit_redacted.csv (sample audit log export, redacted PII)
   - key_rotation_events_2027-03-01_to_2027-04-30.json (redacted; shows rotation metadata)
   - admin_console_iam_roles_screenshot.pdf (screenshot with timestamps)

3) Delivery cadence: initial crosswalk + artifact bundle by Mon May 3 COB PT. Remaining supporting docs (config screenshots, policy PDFs) to follow in the week of May 10 as needed.

4) SOC/ISO point of contact: Kimberly Park (cc’d) will own artifact delivery and technical questions. I’ll coordinate legal/procurement redlines with Marissa if contract items surface.

Action items for Trident:
   - Confirm whether you need the raw CSV or prefer a zipped sample.
   - Flag any high-priority SIG sections (e.g., cryptography, third-party management) you want prioritized in the crosswalk.

I’ve attached a draft crosswalk (rfi_crosswalk_v1.xlsx) and a small starter bundle with 2 sample exports. Note: the key rotation file is redacted and contains only metadata (no private keys).

Best,
Aditya Rao
Director, Security & Solutions
Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.example.com

---
Attachments: rfi_crosswalk_v1.xlsx (xlsx, 48KB); sample_log_export-2027-04.zip (zip, 2.1MB)
From: aditya_rao@redwood.example.com
To: kimberly_park@redwood.example.com, marissa_cole@redwood.example.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.example.com
Date: Sat, 01 May 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Trident SIG — artifact owners and timeline (please ack)

Team — looping you in on Trident (TRD-2027-045). They asked for a crosswalk and a small set of sample artifacts by COB Mon (May 3). I’ve attached the draft crosswalk and the initial sample bundle I’m sending.

Quick ask: can we split ownership as follows?
   - Kimberly: collect and validate admin console screenshots and IAM export (deliverable: admin_console_iam_roles_screenshot.pdf).
   - Marissa: legal/procurement touchpoint for any contract redlines; stand by for pricing/terms questions.
   - Karthik: confirm whether we can provide the raw audit CSV (redacted) or if we should only provide the zipped sample; also confirm retention policy blurb for logs (they may want a formal statement showing 13-month retention and deletion cadence).

Deadlines: please acknowledge ownership by EOD today and post updates in the linked Drive folder below. If you can get your deliverables into the folder by Sun EOD (May 2) I’ll package and send to Lisa Monday morning so they have it for the review.

Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2bTridentSample

Thanks —
Aditya

---
Quoted: "We can absolutely do that..." (Aditya)
From: Lisa Harper <lisa.harper@tridentnet.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.example.com
Cc: Trident Procurement <procurement@tridentnet.com>
Date: Sun, 02 May 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire (v4) and ask: snapshots + sample exports

Aditya — this is perfect, thank you. Confirming the team is happy to receive the zipped sample bundle (saves us time). Two quick clarifications before you finalize:

1) For the key rotation metadata: we only need the event timestamps and the envelope ID (no key material). Your note indicates redaction, which is good — just confirm the envelope IDs will match the control IDs in the crosswalk.
2) For log exports: a single-day sample from April 14 is ideal (we use it to validate parsing and retention headers). If you can label the CSV with the UTC timestamp and include a short README explaining fields, that’d be great.

If you can drop the final zip into the Drive link and send over the HubSpot deal link, we’ll route to our security triage tomorrow.

One last ask — do you have a SOC 2 PDF or hosted link we can reference in our questionnaire answers? That would speed acceptance in a few sections.

Thanks again —
Lisa

---
